title: Neuromorphic Computing Architectures
desc: Foundations of neuromorphic (brain-inspired) engineering — spiking neural networks, neuro-synaptic cores, and cognitive computing paradigms. No prior neuroscience background required.

title: Cyber-Physical Systems
desc: Applied, analytical, and design foundations of embedded computers that sense and control the physical world through feedback loops — from robotics to the Internet of Things. Includes a hands-on lab.
